top_stories.title: LM Studio Bionic: the AI agent for open models
top_stories.summary: LM Studio has launched LM Studio Bionic, a new AI agent product built around open models. The release marks a significant expansion of the platform beyond its existing local model management features. The announcement comes from the official LM Studio blog.

top_stories.title: AI advice made people less accurate but more confident
top_stories.summary: A study found that receiving AI-generated advice caused people to become less accurate in their judgements while simultaneously increasing their confidence in those judgements. The findings raise concerns about over-reliance on AI decision support tools. The research adds to a growing body of evidence on how AI can suppress critical thinking.

top_stories.title: What AI did to Stack Overflow in a graph
top_stories.summary: A data visualisation using Stack Overflow's own data illustrates a sharp decline in question activity on the platform, widely attributed to the rise of AI coding assistants and tools like ChatGPT. The graph offers a stark visual representation of how generative AI has disrupted developer Q&A communities.

top_stories.title: Moonshot AI suspends new subscriptions due to Kimi K3 demand
top_stories.summary: Moonshot AI has temporarily suspended new subscriptions for its Kimi assistant after overwhelming demand following the release of its Kimi K3 model. The announcement was made via the official Kimi Moonshot Twitter account.

top_stories.title: AI Mania Is Eviscerating Global Decision-Making
top_stories.summary: A long-form essay argues that widespread uncritical adoption of AI in organisational and governmental decision-making is degrading the quality of decisions being made globally. The author contends that institutions are outsourcing judgement to AI systems without adequate scrutiny of outputs or processes.

further_links.title: I hate that I don't hate this song made with Suno
further_links.summary: The Verge explores a song generated using Suno AI music tools, reflecting on the uncomfortable experience of finding AI-generated music genuinely listenable.

further_links.title: A grumpy screed about AI in software engineering
further_links.summary: A software engineer offers a critical perspective on the current state of AI coding tools, questioning the productivity claims and practical realities of using AI in professional software development.

further_links.title: How to Secure AI Tools in Your Business
further_links.summary: An overview of key security considerations businesses should apply when deploying AI tools internally, covering data governance and access controls.

further_links.title: AI Agents for Market Research: How Modern Finance and Strategy Teams Gain Faster Insights
further_links.summary: An examination of how AI agent tools are being adopted by finance and strategy teams to accelerate market research workflows and competitive analysis.
